wrapbox

wrapbox

wrapbox provides R wrappers and utilities for working with hydrological rasters and stream networks using terra, sf, and WhiteboxTools. The package includes tools for converting flow-direction data, extracting stream networks in raster and vector formats, and delineating nested or unnested watersheds from outlet locations.

Installation

Install the development/stable version from GitHub with remotes:

install.packages("remotes")

## development version
remotes::install_github("aterui/wrapbox")

## version-specific installation; the latest sable version is v0.2.1
remotes::install_github("aterui/wrapbox@v0.2.1")

Load the package:

library(wrapbox)
library(terra)
library(sf)

The package uses WhiteboxTools through the R package whitebox. If WhiteboxTools is not yet installed on your computer, install it using:

install.packages("whitebox")
whitebox::install_whitebox()
